item.title: Version 0.1.2
item.description: **What's New in Version 0.1.2**||NL|| ||NL|| **✨ New Features** ||BP|| **Alarms** – now with lock screen support and a new creation UI. ||BP|| **Reworked Now Playing** – backend fixes to resolve incorrect positioning bugs. ||BP|| **Mouse support** – left click to expand, right click to clear timers.||NL|| ||NL||**🐛 Bug Fixes** ||BP|| **Stray windows** causing the lock screen to appear on unlock fixed. ||BP|| **Minor locking visual glitches** resolved. ||BP|| **App not starting correctly in Sequoia** fixed. ||BP|| **Minor animation glitches and pauses** when clearing/dismissing timers fixed. ||BP|| **Tint color in light mode** corrected. ||BP|| **Improved kerning** for all text elements. ||BP|| **Updated notification header** to display “Wick”.||NL||
